messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed another config surge when we bumped route_quota.default yesterday; console showed the change as 'deployed' but latency telemetry lagged and SREs saw a brief error spike.
aj: Which change exactly?
kevin: The default route_quota -> 200. It hit Dedicated pools and we saw 5% elevated 500s for ~3 minutes as quota-manager retried.
tara: Oof. Did the rollout use the dry-run/preview flow?
kevin: Nope, it was applied directly from Console -> Apply. No preflight simulation run.
maria: We should add a lightweight handshake between Console and infra components so Console marks a rollout "committed" only after both quota-manager and router report stable state. Current flip is fire-and-forget.
aj: Proposal: two-phase commit-esque UX: Console posts a config with state=STAGED, runs a fast preflight (simulated QPS + KV cache warmup), then waits for ACKs from quota-manager and routing-proxy. If both return OK within timeout, set state=ACTIVE. Otherwise set state=PAUSED and surface failures.
tara: Add telemetry gate: reject transition to ACTIVE if any of these trigger: p95 latency increase >15% from baseline, error-rate increase >2% absolute, or OOM signals from nodes.
kevin: Sounds good. For speed, the preflight should be a dry-run that replays a small sample of recent requests against the new config. We already have a replay infra — can we reuse it?
aj: Yes, reuse replay service but we need a fast path: sample size tuned to finish <30s for small changes. Also need an idempotent apply header so quota-manager can detect staged vs active and avoid duplicate work.
maria: UX: show staged/preview badge in Console with telemetry snapshot and quick link to full replay results. Also allow operator to force-commit with a reason and an override TTL.
kevin: Implementation nit: quota-manager needs an apply API like POST /v1/configs/apply?mode=staged with body {id, spec, dry_run:false} returning {status, applied_version, drift_warnings:[]}. If mode=staged it should not change runtime until it passes preflight or commit.
aj: Agree. Also add a health-check webhook to the Console so infra can push ACKs to Console: /api/internal/config-ack {config_id, component, status, details}.

deploy-bot: config-apply 1799991120: applied route_quota.default=200 to staging (mode=staged)
ops-bot: replay-job 1799991125: replay sample=1500 requests finished in 18s, p95 delta=+3.2%, errors delta=+0.1%
maria: Replay looks fine for the small sample, but we need more headroom for Dedicated. Let's start a canary: 1% for 10m, then 5% for 20m, then promote.
tara: Add an automatic rollback trigger at each step if any telemetry gate fails. Console should auto-pause and notify #eng-oncall.
kevin: Quick pseudo example for the staged apply header (from client):
```
POST /v1/configs/apply?mode=staged
Headers: X-Requester: console-service, X-Request-Id: abc
Body: {"config_id":"cfg-2026-03-21-01","spec":{...}}
```
Response: {"status":"queued","staged_version":"v42","eta_check":30}
```
aj: We'll need a fallback: if infra ACKs never arrive, Console must force-unwind staged state after TTL and mark as failed with diagnostics.
maria: OK action items: aj - draft API sketch + Console UX badge mock; kevin - quota-manager staged-apply endpoint and preflight hooks; tara - replay sampling strategy + thresholds; I'll draft rollout playbook and ops-notify integration.
aj: I'll post an API PR by EOD and add a short design doc in the config-safety repo.
kevin: I'll prototype staged apply this week and wire simple health webhooks.
ops-bot: note: linked playbook draft -> <https://go/internal/config-rollout-playbook>
maria: thanks everyone — let's keep the canary small and telemetry-driven. :thumbsup:
aj: ack :+1:
kevin: ack :rocket:
tara: ack :eyes:
